---- MODULE ivy_examples_ticket_nested ----
EXTENDS ivy_examples_ticket_nestedDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
LOCAL TN_NI == INSTANCE NaturalsInduction

(***************************************************************************)
(* The inductive invariant.  Besides typing it records that `service' never *)
(* overtakes `next_ticket', that an active thread holds a ticket in         *)
(* service .. next_ticket-1, that a thread in the critical section holds    *)
(* exactly the ticket being served, that distinct active threads hold       *)
(* distinct tickets, and that every ticket in service .. next_ticket-1 is   *)
(* held by some active thread.                                             *)
(***************************************************************************)
TN_Inv ==
  /\ pc \in [Thread -> {"Idle", "Waiting", "Critical"}]
  /\ service \in Nat
  /\ next_ticket \in Nat
  /\ m \in [Thread -> Nat]
  /\ c \in [Thread -> Nat]
  /\ service <= next_ticket
  /\ \A u \in Thread : pc[u] # "Idle" => (service <= m[u] /\ m[u] < next_ticket)
  /\ \A u \in Thread : pc[u] = "Critical" => m[u] = service
  /\ \A u1, u2 \in Thread :
        (pc[u1] # "Idle" /\ pc[u2] # "Idle" /\ m[u1] = m[u2]) => u1 = u2
  /\ \A j \in Nat :
        (service <= j /\ j < next_ticket) =>
          (\E u \in Thread : pc[u] # "Idle" /\ m[u] = j)

(***************************************************************************)
(* Formulas that have to be instantiated at several arguments are wrapped   *)
(* in operators, so that the instantiation happens on first-order           *)
(* obligations with the temporal operators hidden inside the definition.    *)
(***************************************************************************)
TN_En(u) == ENABLED <<Step(u)>>_vars
TN_Fair(u) == WF_vars(Step(u))
TN_FairA == \A t \in Thread : TN_Fair(t)
TN_BN == [][Next]_vars
TN_BI == []TN_Inv

TN_Crit(t) == pc[t] = "Critical"
TN_Src(t, d) == TN_Inv /\ pc[t] = "Waiting" /\ m[t] <= service + d
TN_HW(t, u, d) == /\ TN_Inv /\ pc[t] = "Waiting" /\ m[t] = service + d + 1
                  /\ pc[u] = "Waiting" /\ m[u] = service
TN_HC(t, u, d) == /\ TN_Inv /\ pc[t] = "Waiting" /\ m[t] = service + d + 1
                  /\ pc[u] = "Critical" /\ m[u] = service
TN_HCj(t, u, d, j) == TN_HC(t, u, d) /\ c[u] <= j
TN_H(t, u, d) == /\ TN_Inv /\ pc[t] = "Waiting" /\ m[t] = service + d + 1
                 /\ pc[u] # "Idle" /\ m[u] = service

TN_PJ(t, u, d, j) == [](TN_HCj(t, u, d, j) => <>TN_Src(t, d))
TN_QJS(t, u, d, j) ==
  [](TN_HCj(t, u, d, j+1) => <>(TN_HCj(t, u, d, j) \/ TN_Src(t, d)))
TN_QW(t, u, d) == [](TN_HW(t, u, d) => <>TN_HC(t, u, d))
TN_QC(t, u, d) == [](TN_HC(t, u, d) => <>TN_Src(t, d))
TN_PU(t, u, d) == [](TN_H(t, u, d) => <>TN_Src(t, d))
TN_PS(t, d) == [](TN_Src(t, d+1) => <>TN_Src(t, d))
TN_PD(t, d) == [](TN_Src(t, d) => <>TN_Crit(t))
TN_PW(t) == (pc[t] = "Waiting") ~> (pc[t] = "Critical")

TN_C1(t) == TN_BN /\ TN_Fair(t) => TN_PD(t, 0)
TN_C2(t, u, d) == TN_BN /\ TN_Fair(u) => TN_QW(t, u, d)
TN_C3(t, u, d) == TN_BN /\ TN_Fair(u) => TN_PJ(t, u, d, 0)
TN_C4(t, u, d, j) == TN_BN /\ TN_Fair(u) => TN_QJS(t, u, d, j)

TN_B5(t, u, d) ==
  []((\A j \in Nat : (TN_HCj(t, u, d, j) => <>TN_Src(t, d))) /\ TN_HC(t, u, d)
       => <>TN_Src(t, d))
TN_B6(t, u, d) == [](TN_H(t, u, d) => (TN_HW(t, u, d) \/ TN_HC(t, u, d)))
TN_B7(t, d) ==
  []((\A u \in Thread : (TN_H(t, u, d) => <>TN_Src(t, d))) /\ TN_Src(t, d+1)
       => (TN_Src(t, d) \/ <>TN_Src(t, d)))
TN_B8(t) ==
  []((\A d \in Nat : (TN_Src(t, d) => <>TN_Crit(t)))
       /\ TN_Inv /\ pc[t] = "Waiting" => <>TN_Crit(t))

(***************************************************************************)
(* TN_Inv is an inductive invariant, and it implies mutual exclusion.       *)
(***************************************************************************)
LEMMA TN_InitInv == Init => TN_Inv
  BY SMTT("r30") DEF Init, TN_Inv

LEMMA TN_NextInv == TN_Inv /\ [Next]_vars => TN_Inv'
  BY SMTT("r30") DEF TN_Inv, vars, Next, Step, TakeTicket, EnterCritical,
                     RunNestedTask, LeaveCritical

LEMMA TN_BoxInv == SafetySpec => []TN_Inv
  BY TN_InitInv, TN_NextInv, PTL DEF SafetySpec

LEMMA TN_InvMutex == TN_Inv => MutualExclusion
  BY SMTT("r30") DEF TN_Inv, MutualExclusion

(***************************************************************************)
(* What Spec provides.                                                     *)
(***************************************************************************)
LEMMA TN_SpecBN == Spec => TN_BN
  BY DEF Spec, SafetySpec, TN_BN

LEMMA TN_SpecFairA == Spec => TN_FairA
  BY DEF Spec, TN_FairA, TN_Fair

LEMMA TN_SpecBI == Spec => TN_BI
  BY TN_BoxInv DEF Spec, TN_BI

(***************************************************************************)
(* A thread's own step is enabled while it waits for a ticket that is       *)
(* already being served, and while it sits in the critical section.        *)
(***************************************************************************)
LEMMA TN_EnW ==
  ASSUME NEW u \in Thread, TN_Inv, pc[u] = "Waiting", m[u] <= service
  PROVE  TN_En(u)
<1>1. ENABLED <<EnterCritical(u, m[u])>>_vars
  BY ExpandENABLED, SMTT("r30") DEF TN_Inv, EnterCritical, vars
<1>2. QED
  BY <1>1, ExpandENABLED, SMTT("r30")
     DEF TN_En, Step, TakeTicket, EnterCritical, RunNestedTask, LeaveCritical,
         vars

LEMMA TN_EnC ==
  ASSUME NEW u \in Thread, TN_Inv, pc[u] = "Critical"
  PROVE  TN_En(u)
<1>1. CASE c[u] = 0
  <2>1. ENABLED <<LeaveCritical(u)>>_vars
    BY <1>1, ExpandENABLED, SMTT("r30") DEF TN_Inv, LeaveCritical, vars
  <2>2. QED
    BY <2>1, ExpandENABLED, SMTT("r30")
       DEF TN_En, Step, TakeTicket, EnterCritical, RunNestedTask,
           LeaveCritical, vars
<1>2. CASE c[u] # 0
  <2>1. c[u] - 1 \in Nat /\ c[u] = (c[u] - 1) + 1
    BY <1>2, SMTT("r30") DEF TN_Inv
  <2>2. PICK k \in Nat : c[u] = k + 1
    BY <2>1, Zenon
  <2>3. ENABLED <<RunNestedTask(u, k)>>_vars
    BY <2>2, ExpandENABLED, SMTT("r30") DEF TN_Inv, RunNestedTask, vars
  <2>4. QED
    BY <2>2, <2>3, ExpandENABLED, SMTT("r30")
       DEF TN_En, Step, TakeTicket, EnterCritical, RunNestedTask,
           LeaveCritical, vars
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2

(***************************************************************************)
(* Weak fairness of the waiting thread's own step: if its ticket is already *)
(* being served, it enters the critical section.                           *)
(***************************************************************************)
LEMMA TN_LW1 == ASSUME NEW t \in Thread PROVE TN_C1(t)
<1>1. TN_Src(t, 0) /\ [Next]_vars => (TN_Src(t, 0)' \/ TN_Crit(t)')
  BY TN_NextInv, SMTT("r30")
     DEF TN_Src, TN_Crit, TN_Inv, vars, Next, Step, TakeTicket, EnterCritical,
         RunNestedTask, LeaveCritical
<1>2. TN_Src(t, 0) /\ <<Step(t)>>_vars => TN_Crit(t)'
  BY SMTT("r30")
     DEF TN_Src, TN_Crit, TN_Inv, vars, Step, TakeTicket, EnterCritical,
         RunNestedTask, LeaveCritical
<1>3. TN_Src(t, 0) => ENABLED <<Step(t)>>_vars
  <2> SUFFICES ASSUME TN_Src(t, 0) PROVE ENABLED <<Step(t)>>_vars
    OBVIOUS
  <2>1. TN_Inv /\ pc[t] = "Waiting" /\ m[t] <= service
    BY SMTT("r30") DEF TN_Src, TN_Inv
  <2>2. TN_En(t)  BY <2>1, TN_EnW
  <2>3. QED BY <2>2 DEF TN_En
<1>4. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, PTL DEF TN_C1, TN_BN, TN_Fair, TN_PD

(***************************************************************************)
(* Weak fairness of the ticket holder's step: from `Waiting' it enters the  *)
(* critical section.                                                        *)
(***************************************************************************)
LEMMA TN_LW2 ==
  ASSUME NEW t \in Thread, NEW u \in Thread, NEW d \in Nat
  PROVE  TN_C2(t, u, d)
<1>1. TN_HW(t, u, d) /\ [Next]_vars => (TN_HW(t, u, d)' \/ TN_HC(t, u, d)')
  BY TN_NextInv, SMTT("r30")
     DEF TN_HW, TN_HC, TN_Inv, vars, Next, Step, TakeTicket, EnterCritical,
         RunNestedTask, LeaveCritical
<1>2. TN_HW(t, u, d) /\ <<Step(u)>>_vars => TN_HC(t, u, d)'
  BY TN_NextInv, SMTT("r30")
     DEF TN_HW, TN_HC, TN_Inv, vars, Next, Step, TakeTicket, EnterCritical,
         RunNestedTask, LeaveCritical
<1>3. TN_HW(t, u, d) => ENABLED <<Step(u)>>_vars
  <2> SUFFICES ASSUME TN_HW(t, u, d) PROVE ENABLED <<Step(u)>>_vars
    OBVIOUS
  <2>1. TN_Inv /\ pc[u] = "Waiting" /\ m[u] <= service
    BY SMTT("r30") DEF TN_HW, TN_Inv
  <2>2. TN_En(u)  BY <2>1, TN_EnW
  <2>3. QED BY <2>2 DEF TN_En
<1>4. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, PTL DEF TN_C2, TN_BN, TN_Fair, TN_QW

(***************************************************************************)
(* Weak fairness of the ticket holder's step: with an exhausted nested      *)
(* counter it leaves the critical section, which advances `service'.        *)
(***************************************************************************)
LEMMA TN_LW3 ==
  ASSUME NEW t \in Thread, NEW u \in Thread, NEW d \in Nat
  PROVE  TN_C3(t, u, d)
<1>1. TN_HCj(t, u, d, 0) /\ [Next]_vars
        => (TN_HCj(t, u, d, 0)' \/ TN_Src(t, d)')
  BY TN_NextInv, SMTT("r30")
     DEF TN_HCj, TN_HC, TN_Src, TN_Inv, vars, Next, Step, TakeTicket,
         EnterCritical, RunNestedTask, LeaveCritical
<1>2. TN_HCj(t, u, d, 0) /\ <<Step(u)>>_vars => TN_Src(t, d)'
  BY TN_NextInv, SMTT("r30")
     DEF TN_HCj, TN_HC, TN_Src, TN_Inv, vars, Next, Step, TakeTicket,
         EnterCritical, RunNestedTask, LeaveCritical
<1>3. TN_HCj(t, u, d, 0) => ENABLED <<Step(u)>>_vars
  <2> SUFFICES ASSUME TN_HCj(t, u, d, 0) PROVE ENABLED <<Step(u)>>_vars
    OBVIOUS
  <2>1. TN_Inv /\ pc[u] = "Critical"
    BY SMTT("r30") DEF TN_HCj, TN_HC
  <2>2. TN_En(u)  BY <2>1, TN_EnC
  <2>3. QED BY <2>2 DEF TN_En
<1>4. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, PTL DEF TN_C3, TN_BN, TN_Fair, TN_PJ

(***************************************************************************)
(* Weak fairness of the ticket holder's step: one nested task is run, so    *)
(* its counter goes down by one.                                            *)
(***************************************************************************)
LEMMA TN_LW4 ==
  ASSUME NEW t \in Thread, NEW u \in Thread, NEW d \in Nat, NEW j \in Nat
  PROVE  TN_C4(t, u, d, j)
<1>1. TN_HCj(t, u, d, j+1) /\ [Next]_vars
        => (TN_HCj(t, u, d, j+1)' \/ (TN_HCj(t, u, d, j) \/ TN_Src(t, d))')
  BY TN_NextInv, SMTT("r30")
     DEF TN_HCj, TN_HC, TN_Src, TN_Inv, vars, Next, Step, TakeTicket,
         EnterCritical, RunNestedTask, LeaveCritical
<1>2. TN_HCj(t, u, d, j+1) /\ <<Step(u)>>_vars
        => (TN_HCj(t, u, d, j) \/ TN_Src(t, d))'
  BY TN_NextInv, SMTT("r30")
     DEF TN_HCj, TN_HC, TN_Src, TN_Inv, vars, Next, Step, TakeTicket,
         EnterCritical, RunNestedTask, LeaveCritical
<1>3. TN_HCj(t, u, d, j+1) => ENABLED <<Step(u)>>_vars
  <2> SUFFICES ASSUME TN_HCj(t, u, d, j+1) PROVE ENABLED <<Step(u)>>_vars
    OBVIOUS
  <2>1. TN_Inv /\ pc[u] = "Critical"
    BY SMTT("r30") DEF TN_HCj, TN_HC
  <2>2. TN_En(u)  BY <2>1, TN_EnC
  <2>3. QED BY <2>2 DEF TN_En
<1>4. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, PTL DEF TN_C4, TN_BN, TN_Fair, TN_QJS

(***************************************************************************)
(* The state level facts used to eliminate the quantified indices, stated   *)
(* in already boxed form.                                                  *)
(***************************************************************************)
LEMMA TN_LB5 ==
  ASSUME NEW t \in Thread, NEW u \in Thread, NEW d \in Nat
  PROVE  TN_B5(t, u, d)
<1>1. (\A j \in Nat : (TN_HCj(t, u, d, j) => <>TN_Src(t, d))) /\ TN_HC(t, u, d)
        => <>TN_Src(t, d)
  BY SMTT("r30") DEF TN_HCj, TN_HC, TN_Inv
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, PTL DEF TN_B5

LEMMA TN_LB6 ==
  ASSUME NEW t \in Thread, NEW u \in Thread, NEW d \in Nat
  PROVE  TN_B6(t, u, d)
<1>1. TN_H(t, u, d) => (TN_HW(t, u, d) \/ TN_HC(t, u, d))
  BY SMTT("r30") DEF TN_H, TN_HW, TN_HC, TN_Inv
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, PTL DEF TN_B6

LEMMA TN_LB7 ==
  ASSUME NEW t \in Thread, NEW d \in Nat
  PROVE  TN_B7(t, d)
<1>1. (\A u \in Thread : (TN_H(t, u, d) => <>TN_Src(t, d))) /\ TN_Src(t, d+1)
        => (TN_Src(t, d) \/ <>TN_Src(t, d))
  BY SMTT("r30") DEF TN_H, TN_Src, TN_Inv
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, PTL DEF TN_B7

LEMMA TN_LB8 == ASSUME NEW t \in Thread PROVE TN_B8(t)
<1>1. (\A d \in Nat : (TN_Src(t, d) => <>TN_Crit(t)))
        /\ TN_Inv /\ pc[t] = "Waiting" => <>TN_Crit(t)
  BY SMTT("r30") DEF TN_Src, TN_Inv
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, PTL DEF TN_B8

(***************************************************************************)
(* Assembling the leads-to chain.                                          *)
(***************************************************************************)
LEMMA TN_LtBase ==
  ASSUME NEW t \in Thread, TN_BN, TN_FairA
  PROVE  TN_PD(t, 0)
<1>1. TN_C1(t)    BY TN_LW1
<1>2. TN_Fair(t)  BY DEF TN_FairA
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2 DEF TN_C1

LEMMA TN_LtHW ==
  ASSUME NEW t \in Thread, NEW u \in Thread, NEW d \in Nat, TN_BN, TN_FairA
  PROVE  TN_QW(t, u, d)
<1>1. TN_C2(t, u, d)  BY TN_LW2
<1>2. TN_Fair(u)      BY DEF TN_FairA
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2 DEF TN_C2

LEMMA TN_LtHCj0 ==
  ASSUME NEW t \in Thread, NEW u \in Thread, NEW d \in Nat, TN_BN, TN_FairA
  PROVE  TN_PJ(t, u, d, 0)
<1>1. TN_C3(t, u, d)  BY TN_LW3
<1>2. TN_Fair(u)      BY DEF TN_FairA
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2 DEF TN_C3

LEMMA TN_LtHCjS ==
  ASSUME NEW t \in Thread, NEW u \in Thread, NEW d \in Nat, NEW j \in Nat,
         TN_BN, TN_FairA
  PROVE  TN_QJS(t, u, d, j)
<1>1. TN_C4(t, u, d, j)  BY TN_LW4
<1>2. TN_Fair(u)         BY DEF TN_FairA
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2 DEF TN_C4

LEMMA TN_LtHCjAll ==
  ASSUME NEW t \in Thread, NEW u \in Thread, NEW d \in Nat, TN_BN, TN_FairA
  PROVE  \A j \in Nat : TN_PJ(t, u, d, j)
<1>1. TN_PJ(t, u, d, 0)  BY TN_LtHCj0
<1>2. ASSUME NEW j \in Nat PROVE TN_PJ(t, u, d, j) => TN_PJ(t, u, d, j+1)
  <2>1. TN_QJS(t, u, d, j)  BY TN_LtHCjS
  <2>2. QED BY <2>1, PTL DEF TN_PJ, TN_QJS
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, TN_NI!NatInduction

LEMMA TN_LtHC ==
  ASSUME NEW t \in Thread, NEW u \in Thread, NEW d \in Nat,
         \A j \in Nat : TN_PJ(t, u, d, j)
  PROVE  TN_QC(t, u, d)
<1>1. \A j \in Nat : [](TN_HCj(t, u, d, j) => <>TN_Src(t, d))
  BY DEF TN_PJ
<1>2. [](\A j \in Nat : (TN_HCj(t, u, d, j) => <>TN_Src(t, d)))
  BY <1>1
<1>3. TN_B5(t, u, d)  BY TN_LB5
<1>4. QED BY <1>2, <1>3, PTL DEF TN_QC, TN_B5

LEMMA TN_LtH ==
  ASSUME NEW t \in Thread, NEW u \in Thread, NEW d \in Nat,
         TN_QW(t, u, d), TN_QC(t, u, d)
  PROVE  TN_PU(t, u, d)
<1>1. TN_B6(t, u, d)  BY TN_LB6
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, PTL DEF TN_PU, TN_QW, TN_QC, TN_B6

LEMMA TN_LtHall ==
  ASSUME NEW t \in Thread, NEW u \in Thread, NEW d \in Nat, TN_BN, TN_FairA
  PROVE  TN_PU(t, u, d)
<1>1. \A j \in Nat : TN_PJ(t, u, d, j)  BY TN_LtHCjAll
<1>2. TN_QC(t, u, d)  BY <1>1, TN_LtHC
<1>3. TN_QW(t, u, d)  BY TN_LtHW
<1>4. QED BY <1>2, <1>3, TN_LtH

LEMMA TN_LtSrcStep ==
  ASSUME NEW t \in Thread, NEW d \in Nat,
         \A u \in Thread : TN_PU(t, u, d)
  PROVE  TN_PS(t, d)
<1>1. \A u \in Thread : [](TN_H(t, u, d) => <>TN_Src(t, d))
  BY DEF TN_PU
<1>2. [](\A u \in Thread : (TN_H(t, u, d) => <>TN_Src(t, d)))
  BY <1>1
<1>3. TN_B7(t, d)  BY TN_LB7
<1>4. QED BY <1>2, <1>3, PTL DEF TN_PS, TN_B7

LEMMA TN_LtSrcS2 ==
  ASSUME NEW t \in Thread, NEW d \in Nat, TN_BN, TN_FairA
  PROVE  TN_PS(t, d)
<1>1. \A u \in Thread : TN_PU(t, u, d)  BY TN_LtHall
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, TN_LtSrcStep

LEMMA TN_LtSrcAll ==
  ASSUME NEW t \in Thread, TN_BN, TN_FairA
  PROVE  \A d \in Nat : TN_PD(t, d)
<1>1. TN_PD(t, 0)  BY TN_LtBase
<1>2. ASSUME NEW d \in Nat PROVE TN_PD(t, d) => TN_PD(t, d+1)
  <2>1. TN_PS(t, d)  BY TN_LtSrcS2
  <2>2. QED BY <2>1, PTL DEF TN_PD, TN_PS
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, TN_NI!NatInduction

LEMMA TN_LtWait ==
  ASSUME NEW t \in Thread, TN_BI, \A d \in Nat : TN_PD(t, d)
  PROVE  TN_PW(t)
<1>1. \A d \in Nat : [](TN_Src(t, d) => <>TN_Crit(t))
  BY DEF TN_PD
<1>2. [](\A d \in Nat : (TN_Src(t, d) => <>TN_Crit(t)))
  BY <1>1
<1>3. TN_B8(t)  BY TN_LB8
<1>4. QED BY <1>2, <1>3, PTL DEF TN_PW, TN_Crit, TN_B8, TN_BI

LEMMA TN_LtWaitAll ==
  ASSUME NEW t \in Thread, TN_BN, TN_FairA, TN_BI
  PROVE  TN_PW(t)
<1>1. \A d \in Nat : TN_PD(t, d)  BY TN_LtSrcAll
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, TN_LtWait
\* END AGENT HELPERS

THEOREM Safety == SafetySpec => []MutualExclusion
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF ivy_examples_ticket_nested/ivy_examples_ticket_nested_Safety.tla
  BY TN_BoxInv, TN_InvMutex, PTL
\* END AGENT PROOF ivy_examples_ticket_nested/ivy_examples_ticket_nested_Safety.tla

THEOREM Liveness == Spec => NonStarvation
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF ivy_examples_ticket_nested/ivy_examples_ticket_nested_Liveness.tla
<1> SUFFICES ASSUME Spec PROVE NonStarvation
  OBVIOUS
<1>1. TN_BN     BY TN_SpecBN
<1>2. TN_FairA  BY TN_SpecFairA
<1>3. TN_BI     BY TN_SpecBI
<1>4. \A t \in Thread : TN_PW(t)  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, TN_LtWaitAll
<1>5. QED BY <1>4 DEF NonStarvation, TN_PW
\* END AGENT PROOF ivy_examples_ticket_nested/ivy_examples_ticket_nested_Liveness.tla
====
